facts.text: Rock and roll originated in the southern United States in the early 1950s
facts.voiceNarration: Did you know that rock and roll was born in the southern US in the 50s?
facts.imageDescription: Vintage cars driving down a rural road, musicians playing guitars, classic American landscape

facts.text: Chuck Berry's guitar riffs were considered revolutionary for their time
facts.voiceNarration: Chuck Berry's guitar riffs changed music forever with their bold style!
facts.imageDescription: Chuck Berry performing on stage, spotlight shining, guitar in hand, 50s rockabilly attire

facts.text: The first rock and roll song was 'That'll Be the Day' by Buddy Holly
facts.voiceNarration: Buddy Holly's 'That'll Be the Day' is widely considered the first true rock and roll song!
facts.imageDescription: Vintage black and white photo of Buddy Holly, microphone in hand, 50s rockstar pose

facts.text: Elvis Presley was initially called 'the Hillbilly Cat' before his fame
facts.voiceNarration: Elvis started out as the Hillbilly Cat from Tupelo, Mississippi!
facts.imageDescription: Vintage photo of Elvis Presley with guitar, dressed in 50s country attire, rural American landscape

facts.text: The Beatles released 'Love Me Do' in 1962, their first single
facts.voiceNarration: The Beatles kicked off their career with the catchy 'Love Me Do'!
facts.imageDescription: Vintage photo of The Beatles band members, smiling and holding guitars, 60s British Invasion style

facts.text: Jimi Hendrix's guitar playing was heavily influenced by blues
facts.voiceNarration: Jimi Hendrix's innovative playing was deeply rooted in the blues!
facts.imageDescription: Vintage photo of Jimi Hendrix on stage, wearing colorful clothing, playing his iconic Fender Stratocaster

facts.text: The Rolling Stones' 'Satisfaction' was one of the first rock songs to use distortion
facts.voiceNarration: Keith Richards' riff in The Rolling Stones' 'Satisfaction' was a game-changer for rock music!
facts.imageDescription: Vintage photo of Keith Richards playing his guitar, with distortion and feedback effects, 60s psychedelic art style

facts.text: Pink Floyd's 'Dark Side of the Moon' spent 741 weeks on the Billboard chart
facts.voiceNarration: Pink Floyd's iconic album 'The Dark Side of the Moon' became a timeless classic!
facts.imageDescription: Vintage photo of Pink Floyd band members, wearing psychedelic clothing, holding instruments, 70s music scene

facts.text: Queen's 'Bohemian Rhapsody' was initially rejected by several radio stations
facts.voiceNarration: Queen's epic 'Bohemian Rhapsody' faced initial rejection from some radio stations!
facts.imageDescription: Vintage photo of Queen band members, wearing dramatic clothing, holding microphones, 70s rock opera style

facts.text: Guns N' Roses' 'Sweet Child O' Mine' features a distinctive guitar solo by Slash
facts.voiceNarration: Slash's iconic guitar work in Guns N' Roses' 'Sweet Child O' Mine' is forever etched in music history!
facts.imageDescription: Vintage photo of Slash playing his guitar, with Axl Rose singing, 80s rockstar pose
